# Harshadeva Priyankara Bandara

> Senior full-stack engineer and technical lead based in Colombo, Sri Lanka (UTC+5:30), with 7+ years of production Laravel/PHP experience. Specializes in backend systems: fintech and transaction platforms, multi-tenant SaaS (database-per-tenant, modular monolith), ERPs, admin panels, and performance optimization. Available for freelance and contract work with clients worldwide.

Also known as: Harshadeva Bandara, Harshadeva Priyankara, H. P. Bandara.

## Key facts

- Role: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Tech Lead (Senior Software Engineer at Webmotech Pvt Ltd since September 2022)
- Experience: building Laravel systems in production since 2019
- Built a fintech platform handling about 100 transactions per second, with 100+ payment gateways and services integrated, idempotent processing, retries, duplicate-charge prevention and webhook reconciliation
- Architected an ERP serving 4,000+ organizations nationwide, with real-time reporting over server-sent events
- Builds multi-tenant SaaS with a dedicated database per tenant, inside a modular monolith
- Cut a critical report's response time from 2 minutes to 2 seconds, and cut AWS infrastructure costs by 40%
- Leads development teams: architecture decisions, code review, mentoring, stakeholder communication
- Education: BSc (Hons) in Computer Science, University of Bolton (UK)
- Engagement: hourly or fixed price; rates discussed directly

## How he works

1. Understand the problem: users, risks, constraints, definition of done
2. Draw and document: diagrams and a written scope until everyone shares the same understanding
3. Slice the scope into small deliverable pieces and estimate each one
4. Build in short agile phases; the client reviews working software at the end of each phase
5. Ship with guardrails: code review, CI/CD, static analysis
6. Observe: logging, metrics and alerts from day one

Principles: SOLID, ACID, DRY, and quality over rushing ("saving one week with rushed work costs about a month later").
